data.name: LowStock_Intro
data.value: These items are at or below their minimum stock. The ones that fell since the last email are marked as new.

data.name: LowStock_Footer
data.value: Zalihe sends this email at most once a day, when an item falls to its minimum stock or runs out.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Intro
data.value: Since {0} Zalihe can't connect to the shop {1}. Until it works again, stock from Zalihe isn't sent to the shop, and orders that didn't arrive right away are applied only once the connection works.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Reason_channel.unreachable
data.value: The shop can't be reached. Check that the site is up.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Reason_channel.unauthorized
data.value: The shop rejected the keys. Check whether they were revoked or their “Read/Write” permission changed, then replace them in Zalihe.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Reason_channel.not_woocommerce
data.value: WooCommerce is no longer found at the shop's address. Check that the plugin is active.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Reason_channel.unexpected_response
data.value: The shop answered unexpectedly. Usually a security plugin (e.g. Wordfence) or a cache is blocking the REST API.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Reason_Unknown
data.value: The shop didn't answer as expected.

data.name: ChannelFailure_Footer
data.value: Once the connection works, Zalihe carries on by itself. This email comes once per outage.
